criteria.requirement: A recognizable, detailed 3D mechanical watch exposes an internal movement rather than a static picture.
criteria.action: Inspect the assembled watch and its internal movement.
criteria.expected: A recognizable 3D mechanical watch contains inspectable internal components.

criteria.requirement: Disassembly separates meaningful watch components and reassembly restores their coherent arrangement.
criteria.action: Disassemble and reassemble the watch, then repeat.
criteria.expected: Meaningful parts separate and return to their coherent assembled positions.

criteria.requirement: Tiny gears visibly turn in a way that communicates a working mechanical movement.
criteria.action: Observe the exposed gears at several time points.
criteria.expected: Tiny gears visibly turn and communicate an operating mechanical movement.

criteria.requirement: The user can inspect the inside and manipulate available views without losing access to assembly controls.
criteria.action: Inspect interior views while switching assembly states.
criteria.expected: The inside remains inspectable and assembly controls remain reachable.

scenarios.instruction: Inspect the assembled watch and movement at close range.
Take it apart, examine the gears over time and inspect interior components.
Reassemble, repeat and use offered views; check for misplaced parts or controls obscured by the model.

Inspect a 390px-wide viewport, including lower controls and focus navigation. Perform the task through the primary UI without relying on precise 3D camera manipulation. Record any clipped, obstructed or unreachable content.
